A group now consolidates. 1.2.0 put several companies in one graph and summed them; 1.3.0 eliminates between them. The consolidation entity holds the group's adjustments, its Closing Book drafts them from the members' books, and its close is the group's close. Around it, the bank feed learned: each counterparty's usual account is suggested, a month of lines is approved in one pass, and a line carries the cash flow row it belongs on.

1.3.0 gathers everything shipped since 1.2.0 (October 7, 2026): fifteen patch releases, each with its own changelog, and the fixes from a review of the series before this release. It is the app half of RoboSystems 1.19.

## Key features

**The group consolidates**

- **Consolidated statements**: on a group parent, Live Statements' Scope control offers _This entity_, _Combined_ and _Consolidated_. Consolidated adds the consolidation entity's eliminations and noncontrolling interest to the combined sum, and the footer says which view it summed.
- **The worksheet**: a fourth Scope option lays the chosen statement out by entity, with one column each for the parent and every member consolidated in full, then _Combined_, the consolidation entity's adjustments, and _Consolidated_. A member on the equity method or at cost stands beside the sum, never in it.
- **Treatment and the consolidation entity**: an entity is created with how the group treats it (in full, equity method, at cost, or not consolidated) or as the group's consolidation entity. The group page shows each member's treatment, and the entity switcher leaves the consolidation entity out, since it holds adjustments, not books.
- **Consolidating entries on the consolidation entity's Closing Book**: the month's entries as the engine computes them from the members' books, one row per kind and member with its basis and amount.
  - A residual between the parent's investment and its share of a member's capital is shown as _withheld until explained_, never drafted.
  - Intercompany figures the two sides disagree on are listed with the amount left in the statements.
  - **Draft entries** writes them as drafts that the month's close posts. Once drafted, the card reads _Up to date: drafted_, and **Draft again** replaces drafts that no longer match the books. An entry the engine could not compute is named, with the reason.
- **The group close**: the close panel explains what holds the group's month and lists the items behind each blocker: the companies that haven't closed it, entries not drafted, differences left unexplained, and consolidated statements that don't foot. _Close with the difference unexplained_ is offered when a residual is the only thing left.
- **Member since**: New Entity takes the month a subsidiary joined, which a group that has closed a month requires.

**The bank feed learns**

- **Connect a bank through Plaid** from the connection marketplace, OAuth banks included. The **Bank Accounts** page lists every bank and card account of the group with its entity and source, and **Move** points a feed account at another entity's chart.
- **Choose the company a feed books to** before Link opens, for Plaid and Mercury alike. Connections sync once a day on their own, and whenever you ask.
- **Learned suggestions**: the Inbox shows where a suggestion came from: _Learned_ (the counterparty's own default), _Bank category_ or _AI_. It also shows the basis, such as "classified to Office supplies on 3 of 3 committed lines". **Remember for** a counterparty moves its default to the account you chose. In a group, each company keeps its own default for a counterparty, on its own chart.
- **Approve in bulk**: tick the suggested lines, or _Select learned_ for the ones whose suggestion is the counterparty's learned default, then **Approve**. A line the server would not take stays, with the reason in plain words.
- **The cash flow row**: a bank line, and each line of a journal entry, can carry the row of the cash flow statement it belongs on, such as a loan drawn, an owner's contribution or equipment bought, in place of its account's default. A posted line is re-tagged in place, closed month included, and a re-tag on a bank line's entry stays with the bank line.

**Closing work**

- **Fiscal calendar setup** moved to the Entities page and asks where the books start before anything is written, so a subsidiary started mid-stream no longer begins two years back. A calendar's start can be moved later.
- **Reconciliations**: attach the statement when recording a balance (PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 25 MB). A statement reconciliation sets how often the statement is issued, lists the lines the bank had not cleared, and carries a statement that ends before month end forward to it.
- **Documents on events**: attach the bill, receipt or invoice behind an Inbox event, download it, or detach it.
- **Remap in one write**: the chart of accounts moves an account's mapping in a single change, says which closed months now read differently on live statements, and shows the reason when a move is refused.

**Smaller**

- The Explorer, Plan and the close's statement refresh read block summaries instead of every block whole, so a large graph's Explorer opens in a fraction of the time.
- The QuickBooks card chooses between write back and shadow; _Native_ is what severing leaves, not a setting.
- The landing page's console card says what `/do` does, and the Plaid tile is live.

## Bug fixes

- Uploads reach storage from the deployed app (the production content security policy now allows the S3 upload hosts), and the Record statement dialog forgets a file from a cancelled opening.
- Every entity-aware call names the entity in scope, so a subsidiary's schedule, Inbox account picker and US-GAAP trial balance act on its own books, not the parent's.
- Drafting the consolidating entries re-reads what holds the group close, so Close is enabled without a refresh.
- Switching entity or month while a read or a draft is still running no longer shows one entity's or month's data under another.
- A refused close, reopen, entity edit, remap or account move shows the server's reason, never a raw error body.
- After a reopen, the month on screen is read again.
- Live Statements names the columns left out because they reach back before the books begin, and says why when every column is left out.
- After any approval, the Inbox re-reads its list, so a line whose suggestion the approval changed never shows the old one. A bulk approval that fails partway says so.
- New Entity offers no second consolidation entity.

## Platform and infrastructure

- **`@robosystems/client` 2.8.1 → 2.21.0**: the Plaid, entity-scoped, reconciliation, document, classification, flow, consolidation and per-entity default reads and writes this release calls. **`@robosystems/core` 0.14.0 → 0.15.0**. **`@robosystems/report-components` 0.8.1 → 0.9.0**, whose Tavi adapter reads the draft's own fact locations.
- **Deploying 1.3.0** requires RoboSystems API **v1.19.1 or later**. Nothing to set before the deploy: no CloudFormation or variable changes.
- The technical documentation references point at `docs/technical/` in the robosystems repository, where the docs moved from the wiki.
